user.title: Add Oneisall feeder
user.description: Enter the local network details for your Oneisall pet feeder. You need the device_id and local_key from the Tuya IoT Cloud developer portal - see the README for step-by-step instructions.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the feeder. Check the IP address, device ID, local key and protocol version.

set_raw_dp.name: Set raw DPS value
set_raw_dp.description: Sends a raw Tuya datapoint value directly to the feeder.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: The config entry ID of the feeder to target.

dp.name: Datapoint number
dp.description: The DP id as a string, e.g. "101".

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to send. Type depends on the datapoint.
